detail.longDescription:
Easy sharing makes communication simpler.
🌍 Easily share location to make communication smootherPureLink:Easy Location Track is a lightweight location sharing tool that helps you, with mutual authorization, view each other's real-time locations with friends and relatives, understand the itinerary dynamics, and maintain better communication when traveling or meeting.
The application operates with a transparent and secure permission mechanism, allowing users to enable, pause or disable location sharing at any time.

⭐ Feature highlights
• Authorized location sharing: Supports sharing of the location area with mutual consent, facilitating daily communication, appointments or travel coordination.
• Device Locator: It can display the location of the device after authorization, prevent loss, or make it more convenient to find your device in case of loss.
• Safe Travel: It offers a stable real-time location refresh, making it easy to keep track of the other party's movement in a timely manner and enhancing the sense of security during daily travel.
• Travel Record: If the other party enters an invitation code to enable trajectory sharing, you can view their recent movement path, which is convenient for grasping their travel route or itinerary situation.
• Simple interface design: Intuitive operation, allowing users to easily manage location sharing, reminders, and contact connections.

🔹 examples of applicable scenarios
When going out on a date with friends, quickly share the location
Check the movement of your companions when traveling
Keep a daily record of your walking or moving routes
Family members voluntarily share location information for communication

🔒 Privacy and permissions statement
All positioning functions of this application require active authorization from the user.      Location information is processed only during the usage period and transmitted in an encrypted manner.      It will not be used for any purposes other than the authorized ones, nor will user data with identifiable information be sold or rented to any third party.      Users can pause or disable location sharing at any time.

💎 Upgrade to unlock all features
• Weekly Plan: $0.99 for the first week, then $6.99/week.
• Annual Plan: $29.99/year.
Subscription automatically renews unless turned off in Google Play Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends.    Payment is charged to your Google Play account at confirmation of purchase.

📱 Easy to get started
1.      Download and install PureLink
2.      Authorize the required location and notification permissions
3.      Generate an authorization code to invite the devices of family members or friends to join the sharing
4.      Open the travel record or reminder area as needed

Easy sharing makes communication simpler.
